title: When the Choir Sings
author: Wren Pemberton
blurb: Yara Underhill, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
